test_title: PYST 127: SSC GD Constable - GA & GK (Held On - 24 Jan, 2023 Shift 4)

question: What is the name of the first woman inspector general to head the Rapid Action Force of the Central Reserve Police Force?
solution:
The correct answer is Annie Abraham. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Annie Abraham **was appointed as the** first woman inspector general** to head the **Rapid Action Force (RAF)** in **February 2020.**
 
• RAF is a specialized wing of the **Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF)** that deals with **riots and crowd control.**
 
• Annie Abraham had earlier served as the **CRPF's first woman spokesperson** and had also headed the **force's Srinagar sector.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Seema Dhundiya** is also a** woman IPS officer **who has made a mark in the field of **law enforcement.**

 
 
• She is known for her work in the area of **women's safety **and has been awarded the **President's Police Medal for Distinguished Service.**
 
 
 
• **Sanjukta Parashar **is a woman **IPS officer from Assam **who has been recognized for her work in **counter-insurgency operations.**
 
 
• She has been awarded the** President's Police Medal** for** Gallantry **and the **Police Medal for Meritorious Service.**
 
 
 
• **Merin Joseph** is a woman** IPS officer** from **Kerala** who gained popularity on social media for her** good looks.**
 
 
• She has also been recognized for her work in **law enforcemen**t, including cracking down on **cybercrime.**
 
 
 
• Hence, the statement "The **correct answer** is option 1, Annie Abraham" is correct.
